objective_contribution: Test whether tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state, with one common budgeted incomplete-output correction, helps GLM-5.3-flash resume useful reasoning after recycling at 8K and improves native ContextBench evidence selection within the same cumulative model input plus output token cap.

question_and_hypotheses.question: With one identical budgeted output-cap correction in both arms, does tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state improve native evidence selection after recycling within the same cumulative model-token cap?

measurement_mapping.native: Paired ContextBench span and file metrics measure source-evidence selection; they do not establish repair correctness or semantic retention by themselves.
measurement_mapping.retention: Successful post-recycle requests bound to fitted state establish exposure; useful retention additionally requires improved native outcomes or correctness evidence.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Only typed incomplete output is recoverable, one correction is allowed, failed bodies are not exposed, state facts remain receipt-bound, and all evictions/corrections are counted.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token, including failed length-limited output, correction request, fitted state, recovery, submission and correction. Tokenizer-only calls are evidence outside the selected optimization cost.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development round cannot establish another window, model, domain, full cohort, semantic retention, or repair correctness.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter first; 8K development before 10K/12K and reserved confirmation.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through eight and the eight exposed development identities are known; reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, replacement, source refresh, threshold change or lucky rerun. Pause on shared failure and retain every attempt.

retained_counterevidence: Round four index recovery had negligible span gain, file regression and 77,656 extra model tokens.
Round five terminal validity did not establish useful state or correctness.
Round six had zero exposure after 21,019 known model tokens.
Round seven achieved four exact presentations but degraded completion at the state-token cap after 99,018 model tokens.
Round eight exact replay validated fitting, but its first control exhausted the 2,048 output-token cap after 67,135 model tokens and H14 remained untested.
Common recovery may add tokens without enough completion or quality benefit; semantic reasoning may remain limiting.
successor_rule: Freeze H18 only after recovery controls, matched design, preflight, source closure, D07/D08 binding and freeze continuity pass. Run each cell once. Passing exposed development evidence may prepare untouched confirmation under fixed acceptance; failure or inconclusive evidence must retain all outcomes and select a reviewed successor. Never rerun unchanged, lower thresholds, infer clearance, or auto-transition benchmarks.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: H18 targets reusable continuity, recovery, completed outcomes and correctness-oriented evidence under total model-token cost.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: H18 directly tests GLM-5.3-flash at 8K before later small windows.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: Fixed ContextBench remains uncleared; development cannot clear it.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Reviewed round-eight failure leads through gap, question, H18/H17/H0, fixed experiment and future observation/decision.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: All weak-quality, token, exposure, fitting and output-cap failures remain constraints.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, exposure, integrity, correctness limits and every model input/output token are separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Exposed 8K only; SWE-bench excluded; full tasks/windows/tiers/repetitions unchanged.
criterion_verdicts.testability: One common bounded correction, one state variable, fixed limits, falsifiers and stopping rules.
